title: LocalAI P2P federation control-record reference
purpose: Source-derived checklist for interpreting the model-free, multi-node federation capture. These entries are expected protocol records and control actions, not messages observed in the runtime experiment.

source_pin.scope: Federated discovery and service-advertisement lifecycle. DHT is disabled in the planned local capture, so DHT traffic is not expected. Model sharding RPC and actual inference are outside this catalogue.

notes: Schedules below are configured intervals or expiry thresholds from source. EdgeVPN implements Announce and ledger synchronization with an exponential backoff ticker (5 second initial interval, randomized, configured maximum), so intervals are not exact packet timings.
The current harness profile disables DHT and leaves mDNS enabled; this states configuration intent, not proof that mDNS or any listed record was seen on the wire.
A record update creates a full new ledger block. Individual application records do not each map to distinct network packets.

peer_discovery.expected: libp2p mDNS discovery followed by peer connection and GossipSub topic participation
peer_discovery.configuration: LocalAI sets MDNS=true, Discovery.Interval=10s; DHT is enabled unless LOCALAI_P2P_DISABLE_DHT=true. The current model-free capture disables DHT.
peer_discovery.dht_status: disabled_by_test_configuration; no DHT rendezvous Advertise/FindPeers is expected

ledger_gossip_envelope.transport: EdgeVPN GossipSub room/topic; the topic is derived from the token and rotates with its configured OTP interval
wire_layers: Application record(s) are stored in a complete ledger Storage map.
The complete Block JSON has fields Index, Timestamp, Storage, Hash, PrevHash; EdgeVPN gzip-compresses it.
The compressed bytes are sealed by EdgeVPN's configured sealer before being written to the hub.
EdgeVPN publishes a JSON hub.Message with fields Message, SenderID, Annotations. SenderID is set from GossipSub's ReceivedFrom on receipt; Annotations is optional.
ledger_gossip_envelope.publish_triggers: Ledger Add/Delete writes a new block and immediately writes it to the hub queue; the periodic synchronizer also republishes the latest full block at its configured interval (10s maximum in LocalAI options).
ledger_gossip_envelope.interpretation: A packet capture may show GossipSub control/data frames and encrypted hub payloads. Do not count each bucket record as its own protocol message.
source: EdgeVPN pkg/blockchain/ledger.go:Syncronizer, Announce, Update, Add, DeleteBucket, writeData (v0.34.0)

records_or_messages.name: mDNS peer discovery and libp2p connection setup
records_or_messages.kind: transport control; no LocalAI ledger record
records_or_messages.fields: mDNS/libp2p implementation-defined; no LocalAI payload schema
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Discovery interval configured to 10s; actual mDNS query/response cadence is implementation-managed

records_or_messages.name: GossipSub room join, subscription and mesh maintenance
records_or_messages.kind: transport control; carries the ledger envelope after topic join
records_or_messages.fields: GossipSub implementation-defined; LocalAI does not define an app-level join record
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: On network start and as libp2p GossipSub maintains the topic mesh; topic key refresh checked once per second, with room rejoin when OTP-derived key changes
records_or_messages.stream_protocol_id: No LocalAI application stream ID; GossipSub uses its library protocols

records_or_messages.name: Explicit membership/join ledger record
records_or_messages.notes: The source paths inspected do not write a distinct peer-joined record. Peers join by discovering/connecting and participating in the token-derived pubsub room; later records advertise liveness/services.

records_or_messages.name: EdgeVPN service route
records_or_messages.key: Random 10-character service ID generated by LocalAI ExposeService
records_or_messages.kind: application ledger record inside full-block envelope
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Announce cap 60s; record is added if missing or if the PeerID has changed, using EdgeVPN's backoff ticker
records_or_messages.notes: This EdgeVPN record resolves the service ID to its libp2p peer. It is distinct from LocalAI's NodeData advertisement; destination address is not a field in types.Service.

records_or_messages.name: LocalAI federated/worker service advertisement
records_or_messages.bucket: <P2PNetworkID>_federated, <P2PNetworkID>_worker, or <P2PNetworkID>_mlx_worker; if P2PNetworkID is empty: federated, worker, or mlx_worker
records_or_messages.kind: application ledger record inside full-block envelope
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Every 20s maximum through Announce/backoff; every advertisement writes current LastSeen and immediately creates a ledger block
records_or_messages.notes: The exact service ID is selected by the caller: FederatedID="federated", LlamaCPPWorkerID="worker", MLXWorkerID="mlx_worker". NetworkID(prefix, serviceID) returns prefix + "_" + serviceID when prefix is nonempty, otherwise serviceID unchanged. In the current capture, the LocalAI app runs the federated mode, so its advertised NodeData bucket is <P2PNetworkID>_federated. This custom bucket is distinct from EdgeVPN’s base "services" bucket. ID is hostname plus the random service name. TunnelAddress and ServiceID are empty in the initial ExposeService record and may be filled in local discovery state later.
records_or_messages.source: LocalAI core/p2p/p2p.go:ExposeService; core/p2p/federated.go:NetworkID; core/p2p/node.go:service ID constants; core/schema/localai.go:NodeData; core/application/p2p.go:StartP2P

records_or_messages.name: Peer authorization/user record
records_or_messages.kind: application ledger record inside full-block envelope; conditionally emitted by LocalAI gateway/tunnel listener
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Every 10s maximum through Announce/backoff when nodeAnnounce is running
records_or_messages.notes: FederatedServer.proxy and allocated local tunnel listeners call nodeAnnounce. EdgeVPN's ServiceProtocol handler checks the connecting peer's ID exists in users before forwarding the TCP stream. A worker process running only ExposeService does not itself call LocalAI nodeAnnounce in this code path.

lifecycle_categories.category: 3. Steady-state liveness, service discovery and ledger sync

records_or_messages.name: EdgeVPN peer heartbeat
records_or_messages.kind: application ledger record inside full-block envelope
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Announce interval 30s maximum; considered live for 15 minutes

records_or_messages.name: LocalAI service heartbeat/LastSeen refresh
records_or_messages.bucket: <P2PNetworkID>_<service ID>; current federation bucket is <P2PNetworkID>_federated; other defined service IDs are <P2PNetworkID>_worker and <P2PNetworkID>_mlx_worker
records_or_messages.kind: application ledger record inside full-block envelope
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Every 20s maximum; ServiceDiscoverer polls the last local ledger block every 5s and marks NodeData offline when LastSeen is older than 40s
records_or_messages.notes: 40s is a LocalAI application liveness test, separate from EdgeVPN's 15-minute healthcheck threshold.
records_or_messages.source: LocalAI core/p2p/p2p.go:ExposeService/discoveryTunnels/ensureService; core/p2p/node.go:service ID constants; core/p2p/federated.go:NetworkID; core/schema/localai.go:NodeData.IsOnline

records_or_messages.name: Full-ledger synchronization
records_or_messages.kind: encrypted/compressed full-block GossipSub payload; not an individual application record
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: 10s maximum from LocalAI Ledger.SyncInterval; EdgeVPN publishes the current last block periodically even if no record changed

records_or_messages.name: Worker selection
records_or_messages.kind: local coordinator decision; no inter-peer control record
records_or_messages.fields: Reads discovered NodeData from local in-memory registry; chooses random or least-used worker according to FederatedServer configuration

records_or_messages.name: Service stream open and authorization check
records_or_messages.kind: libp2p stream setup; stream then carries proxied service bytes (including inference request/response)
records_or_messages.fields: Caller opens a stream to the PeerID stored under the EdgeVPN services key; provider checks the caller PeerID against users
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Per proxied connection; no periodic control message
records_or_messages.notes: There is no additional LocalAI application-level hello record in the inspected path. Model-free test runs exercise no actual inference payload unless explicitly sent.

lifecycle_categories.category: 5. Optional model-state synchronization (federated application mode only)

records_or_messages.name: Shared model-name list
records_or_messages.value: JSON array of model names (empty array for model-free nodes)
records_or_messages.kind: application ledger record inside full-block envelope
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Federated LocalAI app checks state every 60s; AnnounceUpdate is also configured with 60s maximum and writes only when the value differs or is absent
records_or_messages.notes: This record lists model names, not weights or model files. If a peer sees a name it lacks, LocalAI submits a gallery installation operation. p2pSync is started by StartP2P only when the federated mode branch runs; a standalone worker-only P2P node does not run this model-state sync.

lifecycle_categories.category: 6. Graceful stop, crash expiry and rejoin

records_or_messages.name: Explicit leave/de-registration
records_or_messages.kind: not found in inspected LocalAI federation lifecycle
records_or_messages.notes: Cancellation stops LocalAI announce loops and closes listeners. The inspected stop path does not emit a dedicated leave message or delete a peer's services/users record. A full-block deletion is only sent by code paths that explicitly call ledger.Delete/DeleteBucket.

records_or_messages.name: LocalAI service expiry
records_or_messages.kind: local interpretation of stale NodeData; no wire deletion record
records_or_messages.fields: NodeData.LastSeen older than 40s => offline; existing local tunnel allocation may be canceled and removed from the process-local service map
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: ServiceDiscoverer checks ledger every 5s; 40s age threshold
records_or_messages.notes: This does not remove the NodeData key from the replicated ledger. The EdgeVPN services and users buckets have no per-entry TTL in the inspected code, so stale keys may remain until overwritten or a bucket/key deletion is otherwise written.

records_or_messages.name: EdgeVPN heartbeat expiry and scrub
records_or_messages.kind: liveness filtering plus elected bucket maintenance
records_or_messages.fields: healthcheck PeerID timestamps older than 15m are excluded by AvailableNodes; selected leader deletes the entire healthcheck bucket after its 900s scrub timer
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Leader recomputed during heartbeat callback; scrub threshold 900s; heartbeat interval 30s maximum; expiry threshold 15m
records_or_messages.notes: Leader is the currently active PeerID with the highest FNV-1a 32-bit hash. This is deterministic selection, not a persistent leader lease or consensus election. Bucket deletion is a full ledger update, not a distinct leave packet; peers subsequently repopulate their healthcheck entries.
records_or_messages.source: LocalAI core/p2p/p2p.go:newNodeOpts; EdgeVPN pkg/services/alive.go; pkg/utils/leader.go; pkg/blockchain/ledger.go:DeleteBucket

records_or_messages.name: Rejoin after restart
records_or_messages.kind: fresh network participation and repeated advertisements
records_or_messages.fields: peer discovery/topic join, heartbeat and service advertisements resume using the restarted node's current PeerID and LocalAI service name
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Startup plus each record's Announce schedule
records_or_messages.notes: No explicit rejoin record is defined. ExposeService creates a new random 10-character service name each process start; stale old service records are not explicitly removed by the inspected stop path.

records_or_messages.name: Deterministic leader calculation
records_or_messages.kind: local computation over shared healthcheck state; no leader-election message
records_or_messages.inputs: PeerIDs with RFC3339 heartbeat timestamp within 15 minutes
records_or_messages.nominal_schedule: Recomputed on heartbeat callback (30s maximum cadence)
records_or_messages.leader_action: At the 900s scrub threshold, selected leader writes a new ledger block with the entire healthcheck bucket removed; other peers do not delete it.
records_or_messages.notes: Each peer starts its own 900s timer when the AliveNetworkService starts; there is no explicit term/lease or leader announcement. The threshold and action are source-derived; runtime occurrence requires a long run beyond 15 minutes and was not established by the short capture.
records_or_messages.source: EdgeVPN pkg/services/alive.go and pkg/utils/leader.go (v0.34.0); LocalAI core/p2p/p2p.go:newNodeOpts

out_of_scope_for_model_free_run: llama.cpp RPC worker protocol and tensor/model shard traffic
